title: Parcel tracking: scan ingestion that stalls once the pool is busy
name: Scan ingest pool usage

questions.prompt: Every morning when the Rotterdam hub uploads its overnight scanner buffer, scan ingestion freezes. CPU drops to zero, no errors are logged, and the pool metrics show all connections checked out with requests queueing behind them. A restart clears it until the next big upload. Single scans from couriers' handhelds work fine all day. Fix shipments.ts so the tests pass.
